sentences.answer_sanskrit:
विष्णुपुराणात् भक्तध्रुवस्य कथा:
उत्तानपादस्य राजा आसीत्। तस्य सुनीतिः सुरुचिः इति द्वे भार्ये आस्ताम्। सुरुच्याः वचनेन सुनीतेः पुत्रः ध्रुवः पितुः अङ्के उपवेष्टुं न प्राप्नोत्। पञ्चवर्षीयः ध्रुवः वनं गत्वा भगवन्तं विष्णुं ध्यायन् कठोरं तपः अकरोत्। तस्य अनन्यभक्त्या प्रसन्नः श्रीहरिः प्रादुर्भूय तस्मै 'ध्रुवतारा' इति अचलपदं प्रादात्। अद्यापि सः आकाशे उत्तरे दिशि प्रकाशते।
sentences.meaning:
Question 2: Collect any one story from the Puranas, write it down, and narrate it to the class.
Answer: Story of Devotee Dhruva (from Vishnu Purana):
King Uttanapada had two queens, Suniti and Suruchi. Due to Suruchi's harsh words, Suniti's 5-year-old son Dhruva was forbidden to sit in his father's lap. The young boy went into the forest and undertook rigorous penance meditating on Lord Vishnu. Pleased by his unswerving devotion, Lord Vishnu appeared and blessed him with an eternal station as the Pole Star (Dhruva Tara), which shines unmoving in the northern sky.
sentences.hindi_gloss:
प्रश्न २: पुराणों से कोई एक कथा संकलित करके लिखिए और कक्षा में सुनाइए।
उत्तर: विष्णुपुराण से भक्त ध्रुव की कथा:
राजा उत्तानपाद के पुत्र ध्रुव को सौतेली माँ सुरुचि ने पिता की गोद में बैठने से रोक दिया। पाँच वर्ष के बालक ध्रुव ने वन में जाकर भगवान विष्णु की कठोर तपस्या की। उनकी अटूट भक्ति से प्रसन्न होकर भगवान विष्णु ने उन्हें उत्तर दिशा में आकाश में अमर और अचल 'ध्रुव तारा' का स्थान प्रदान किया।
sentences.paragraphTranslation: विष्णुपुराण की प्रसिद्ध भक्त ध्रुव की प्रेरक कथा।

lessons.title: Chapter 8: हितं मनोहारि च दुर्लभं वचः

sentences.meaning: Dialogue: The Treasure of Wise Epigrams (Suktis)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: मूल बातचीत: सूक्तियों की महिमा

sentences.sanskrit: छात्रः: आचार्य ! अद्य मम माता माम् एकां सूक्तिम् अपाठयत् — 'सत्यं वद, धर्मं चर' इति।
sentences.meaning: Student: Teacher! Today my mother taught me an epigram (sukti) — 'Speak truth, practice righteousness.'
sentences.paragraphTranslation: आचार्य! आज मेरी माता ने मुझे एक सूक्ति पढ़ाई— 'सत्य बोलो, धर्म का आचरण करो'।

sentences.meaning: Student: Teacher! What is meant by the word 'Sukti'?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: आचार्य! 'सूक्ति' कहने का क्या अभिप्राय है?

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्यः: सुष्ठु उक्तिः इति सूक्तिः। सुवचनम् इत्यर्थः। अस्माकं संस्कृतसाहित्ये सूक्तीनां विशालः भाण्डागारः अस्ति। एताः सूक्तयः जीवने मार्गदर्शनं कुर्वन्ति।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: 'Su-ukti' means well-spoken words or pearls of wisdom. In our Sanskrit literature there is a vast treasury of wise suktis that offer lifelong guidance.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: सुन्दर और हितकारी वचन को सूक्ति कहते हैं। हमारे संस्कृत साहित्य में सूक्तियों का विशाल भंडार है, जो जीवन में सही मार्गदर्शन करती हैं।

sentences.meaning: Celebrated Sanskrit Aphorisms and Epigrams
sentences.paragraphTranslation: प्रसिद्ध संस्कृत सूक्तियाँ एवं उनके भावार्थ

sentences.meaning: 1. Words that are both wholesome/beneficial and charmingly pleasant are extremely rare in this world.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: १. हितकारी और साथ ही मन को प्रिय लगने वाली वाणी अत्यंत दुर्लभ होती है। (भारवि - किरातार्जुनीयम्)

sentences.meaning: 2. A precious gem does not go searching for an admirer; rather, worthy seekers seek out the gem.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: २. रत्न किसी को ढूँढ़ने नहीं जाता, बल्कि रत्न को सब खोजते हैं। (कालिदास - कुमारसम्भवम्)

sentences.meaning: 3. Good character and noble conduct is the supreme ornament of a human being.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ३. सदाचार और अच्छा चरित्र ही मनुष्य का सबसे श्रेष्ठ आभूषण है।

sentences.meaning: 4. A healthy physical body is indeed the primary instrument for performing all duties and righteousness.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ४. निश्चय ही शरीर ही सभी कर्तव्यों और धर्म को पूरा करने का पहला साधन है।

sentences.sanskrit: ५. गुणाः पूजास्थानं गुणिषु न च लिङ्गं न च वयः । (उत्तररामचरितम्)
sentences.meaning: 5. Among virtuous people, virtues alone command respect— neither gender nor age determines true worth.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ५. गुणवानों में गुणों का ही आदर होता है, लिंग (स्त्री/पुरुष) या आयु का नहीं।

sentences.meaning: 6. The success of noble deeds lies in the inner resolve and courage of great souls, not in outer equipment.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ६. महान लोगों के कार्यों की सफलता उनके आत्मबल और संकल्प पर निर्भर करती है, बाहरी साधनों पर नहीं।

sentences.meaning: 7. Every single moment should be utilized to acquire learning, and every tiny grain/penny to build wealth.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ७. एक-एक पल का उपयोग विद्या के लिए और एक-एक कण का उपयोग धन संचय के लिए करना चाहिए।

sentences.meaning: Key Vocabulary Glossary
sentences.paragraphTranslation: कठिन शब्दों के अर्थ

sentences.meaning: Pleasing to the mind / Charming
Rare / Hard to find
Treasury / Storehouse
Means of fulfilling righteousness
Exercises with Solved Answers
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अभ्यास कार्य

sentences.meaning: What kind of speech is rare? Answer: Beneficial and pleasing words (हितं मनोहारि च वचः).
Does a gem search for an owner? Answer: It does not search; it is sought (न अन्विष्यति, मृग्यते).
What is the supreme adornment of a human being? Answer: Good character (शीलं परं भूषणम्).
What is the primary instrument of Dharma? Answer: The physical body (शरीरम्).

sentences.sanskrit: १. पाठस्य मूल-संवादः (माता और पुत्री के बीच बातचीत)
sentences.meaning: Lesson Introduction: Dialogue on the Cosmic Cycle of Creation and Food
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता और पुत्री के बीच बातचीत: सृष्टि एवं अन्न की उत्पत्ति

sentences.sanskrit: पुत्री: अम्ब ! मम काचिद् जिज्ञासा अस्ति। वयं मनुष्याः प्राणिनः कीटाः च कथं भूलोके आगताः?
sentences.meaning: Daughter: Mother! I have a question born of deep curiosity. How did we human beings, animals, and creatures arrive on this earth?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पुत्री - माँ! मेरी एक जिज्ञासा है। हम मनुष्य, पशु-पक्षी और कीड़े इस धरती पर कैसे आए?

sentences.sanskrit: माता: वत्से ! तदर्थं भवती प्रथमं पृथिव्याः उत्पत्तिक्रमं जानीयात्।
sentences.meaning: Mother: Dear child! For that you must first understand the cosmic sequence of earth's creation.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - बेटी! उसके लिए तुम्हें सबसे पहले पृथ्वी की उत्पत्ति का क्रम जानना चाहिए।

sentences.sanskrit: पुत्री: अहो ! रोचकं स्यात् कृपया श्रावयतु।
sentences.meaning: Daughter: Oh! That must be fascinating, please tell me!
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पुत्री - अरे! यह तो बहुत दिलचस्प होगा, कृपया सुनाइए।

sentences.sanskrit: माता: अस्तु ! प्रथमं ब्रह्मणः आकाशस्य उत्पत्तिः अभवत्।
sentences.meaning: Mother: Very well! First from Brahma (the primordial cosmic conscious energy), Akasha (space/ether) emerged.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - ठीक है! सबसे पहले ब्रह्म (परम चेतना) से आकाश उत्पन्न हुआ।

sentences.meaning: Daughter: Mother, what does 'Brahma' mean?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पुत्री - माँ, ब्रह्म कहने का क्या मतलब है?

sentences.sanskrit: माता: ब्रह्म इत्युक्ते चेतना-शक्तिः, ऊर्जा वा या सर्वत्र व्याप्ता अस्ति। यथा – आकाशः अणुः च सर्वत्र व्याप्तः अस्ति।
sentences.meaning: Mother: Brahma means the omnipresent conscious power or energy that pervades everything, just as space and atomic particles permeate all reality.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - ब्रह्म का अर्थ है वह चेतना-शक्ति या ऊर्जा जो सब जगह फैली हुई है, जैसे आकाश और परमाणु सर्वत्र व्याप्त हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: माता: आकाशात् वायुः उत्पन्नः। वायोः अग्निः उत्पन्नः। अग्नेः जलस्य उत्पत्तिः अभवत्। जलात् पृथिव्याः उत्पत्तिः अभवत्।
sentences.meaning: Mother: From space, Vayu (air/atmosphere) arose. From air, Agni (fire/energy) arose. From fire, Jala (water) arose. From water, Prithvi (earth/matter) formed.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - आकाश से वायु, वायु से अग्नि, अग्नि से जल, और जल से पृथ्वी (धरती) की उत्पत्ति हुई।

sentences.sanskrit: माता: पृथिव्याः ओषधीनां सस्यानां वृक्षादीनां च उत्पत्तिः अभवत्। सस्येभ्यः आहारस्य उत्पत्तिः अभवत्।
sentences.meaning: Mother: From the fertile earth, herbs, crops, and trees blossomed. From agricultural crops, nutritious food (Anna) emerged.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - पृथ्वी से औषधियों, फसलों और पेड़-पौधों की उत्पत्ति हुई। फसलों और वनस्पतियों से आहार (अन्न) उत्पन्न हुआ।

sentences.sanskrit: पुत्री: आम्, आहारात् कीटाः, प्राणिनः, मनुष्याः उत्पन्नाः खलु अम्ब ?
sentences.meaning: Daughter: Yes! And from that sustenance of food, all insects, creatures, and human beings are born and nourished, right Mother?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पुत्री - हाँ, अन्न (भोजन) से ही समस्त कीड़े, पशु-पक्षी और मनुष्य पैदा हुए और पलते हैं ना माँ?

sentences.sanskrit: माता: अहो ! मम पुत्री बहु चतुरा अस्ति। सत्यम् उक्तवती भवती।
sentences.meaning: Mother: Splendid! My daughter is truly clever. You spoke the exact truth.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - अरे! मेरी बेटी बहुत बुद्धिमान है। तुमने बिल्कुल सच कहा।

sentences.sanskrit:
माता: श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतायाम् अपि भगवान् श्रीकृष्णः उक्तवान् —
'अन्नाद् भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः ।
यज्ञाद् भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः ॥'
sentences.meaning: Mother: In the Shrimad Bhagavad Gita, Lord Krishna similarly declares: 'From food all living beings arise; food is produced by rain; rain is generated by yajna (harmonious ecological sacrifice); and yajna is born of dutiful right action.'
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - श्रीमद्भगवद्गीता में भी भगवान श्रीकृष्ण ने कहा है— 'अन्न से सभी प्राणी उत्पन्न होते हैं, अन्न की उत्पत्ति वर्षा से होती है, वर्षा यज्ञ से होती है और यज्ञ सत्कर्मों से उत्पन्न होता है।'

sentences.sanskrit: पुत्री: अहो ! अहम् अपि उपनिषदं गीतां च पठामि अम्ब !
sentences.meaning: Daughter: Oh marvelous! I too shall study the Upanishads and the Gita, Mother!
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पुत्री - वाह माँ! मैं भी उपनिषद और गीता पढ़ूँगी!

sentences.sanskrit: माता: अवश्यम् उपनिषद्-ग्रन्थाः पठनीयाः। यतः अस्माकं भारतस्य मौलिकं ज्ञानं तेषु निहितम् अस्ति।
sentences.meaning: Mother: Certainly, the Upanishads must be studied, for the foundational wisdom of our Bharat is enshrined within them.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - उपनिषद् अवश्य पढ़ने चाहिए क्योंकि भारत का मूल ज्ञान उन्हीं में समाया हुआ है।

sentences.meaning: Key Vocabulary Glossary
sentences.paragraphTranslation: कठिन शब्दों के अर्थ

sentences.meaning: All living beings / creatures
O Mother! (Vocative)
Rain cloud / Rainfall
From the harvested crops
Exercises with Solved Answers
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अभ्यास कार्य

sentences.meaning: What was the daughter's curious question? Answer: How did humans and creatures arrive on earth?
sentences.answer_sanskrit: वयं मनुष्याः प्राणिनः कीटाः च कथं भूलोके आगताः इति।

sentences.meaning: What emerged from Brahma? Answer: Space (आकाशस्य).
From what do all creatures arise? Answer: From food (अन्नात्).
From what is food generated? Answer: From rain (पर्जन्यात्).
Introduction: Sanskrit Olympiad Ranks and the Question of the Tenth
sentences.paragraphTranslation: कक्षा की भूमिका: संस्कृत ओलम्पियाड और 'दसवाँ कौन है?'

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्यः: अयि भोः ! गतसप्ताहे संस्कृत-ओलम्पियाड्-परीक्षा अभवत्। तत्र कः प्रथमं स्थानं प्राप्तवान् ?
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Hello students! Last week was the Sanskrit Olympiad exam. Who secured first place there?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: आचार्य - अरे ओ! पिछले सप्ताह संस्कृत ओलम्पियाड परीक्षा हुई थी। वहाँ किसने पहला स्थान प्राप्त किया?

sentences.sanskrit: छात्रः: महोदय ! विद्याधरः प्रथमं स्थानं प्राप्तवान्। सा प्रीतिः द्वितीया, तृतीया च हेमलता।
sentences.meaning: Student: Sir! Vidyadhara won first place. Preeti was second, and Hemalata was third.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: महोदय! विद्याधर ने पहला स्थान प्राप्त किया, प्रीति दूसरी और हेमलता तीसरी रही।

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्यः: अहो उत्तमम् ! तर्हि दशमः कोऽस्ति भोः ? चिन्ता मास्तु, वयं दशमस्य विषये एकां प्रसिद्धकथां पठामः।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Splendid! Then tell me, who is the tenth? Don't worry, let us read a famous classic story about the 'Tenth Boy'.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: बहुत उत्तम! तो दसवाँ कौन है? चिंता मत करो, आज हम 'दसवें' के विषय में एक प्रसिद्ध कहानी पढ़ते हैं।

sentences.meaning: Main Story: Who is the Tenth? (The Allegory of Self-Forgetfulness)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: मुख्य कथा: दसवाँ कौन है?

sentences.sanskrit: एकदा दश बालकाः स्नानाय नदीम् अगच्छन्। ते नदीजले चिरं स्नानम् अकुर्वन्। ततः ते तीर्त्वा पारं गताः। तदा तेषां नायकः अपृच्छत् – अपि सर्वे बालकाः नदीम् उत्तीर्णाः ?
sentences.meaning: Once, ten boys went to the river to bathe. They bathed in the river water for a long time. Then they swam across to the other shore. Their leader asked: 'Have all the boys safely crossed the river?'
sentences.paragraphTranslation: एक बार दस बालक नहाने के लिए नदी पर गए। उन्होंने देर तक स्नान किया और तैरकर पार चले गए। तब उनके नेता ने पूछा– क्या सभी ने नदी पार कर ली?

sentences.sanskrit: तदा कश्चित् बालकः सर्वान् पङ्क्तौ स्थापयित्वा अगणयत् – एकं, द्वे, त्रीणि, चत्वारि, पञ्च, षट्, सप्त, अष्ट, नव इति। सः आत्मानं न अगणयत्। अतः सः अवदत्- अरे वयं नव एव स्मः भोः! दशमः नास्ति। अपरः अपि बालकः पुनः आत्मानं त्यक्त्वा अन्यान् बालकान् अगणयत्। तदा अपि नव एव आसन्। अतः ते निश्चयम् अकुर्वन् यत् दशमः नद्यां मग्नः। ते विषण्णाः तूष्णीम् अतिष्ठन्।
sentences.meaning: Then one boy lined up everyone and counted: 'One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine.' He forgot to count himself! So he exclaimed: 'Alas! We are only nine! The tenth is missing.' Another boy counted, leaving himself out, and again found only nine. Convinced that the tenth companion had drowned in the river, they sat down weeping in silent grief.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: तब एक बालक ने सबको कतार में खड़ा करके गिना– एक, दो, तीन, चार, पाँच, छह, सात, आठ, नौ। उसने खुद को नहीं गिना और बोला– हम तो नौ ही हैं, दसवाँ नहीं है! दूसरे बालक ने भी खुद को छोड़कर गिना तो नौ ही मिले। उन्होंने मान लिया कि दसवाँ नदी में डूब गया और दुखी होकर बैठ गए।

sentences.sanskrit: तदा कश्चित् पथिकः तत्र आगच्छत्। सः तान् बालकान् दुःखितान् दृष्ट्वा अपृच्छत् – अयि बालकाः! युष्माकं दुःखस्य कारणं किम्? नायकः अकथयत् “वयं दश बालकाः स्नातुम् आगताः। इदानीं नव एव स्मः। एकः नद्यां मग्नः” इति।
sentences.meaning: Just then a wise traveler arrived. Seeing the boys in tears, he asked: 'Children! What is the cause of your sorrow?' The leader replied: 'Ten of us came to bathe. Now we are only nine; one has drowned in the river.'
sentences.paragraphTranslation: तभी एक राहगीर वहाँ आया। उसने दुखी बच्चों से पूछा– तुम्हारे दुःख का क्या कारण है? नेता ने कहा– हम दस नहाने आए थे, अब नौ ही हैं। एक डूब गया।

sentences.sanskrit: पथिकः तान् अगणयत्। तत्र दश बालकाः तु आसन्। सः नायकम् आदिशत् त्वं बालकान् गणय। सः नव बालकान् एव अगणयत्। तदा पथिकः अवदत् – 'दशमः त्वम् असि' इति। तत् श्रुत्वा सर्वे प्रहृष्टाः भूत्वा अकथयन् – 'दशमः प्राप्तः !' ततः सर्वे मिलित्वा आनन्देन गृहम् अगच्छन्।
sentences.meaning: The traveler counted them and saw all ten were present. He instructed the leader: 'Count them again.' The boy counted nine companions. Then the traveler pointed at him and declared: 'Thou art the tenth!' (दशमः त्वम् असि). Hearing this, overjoyed, they shouted: 'The tenth is found!' and happily returned home together.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: यात्री ने गिना तो दस थे। उसने नायक से गिनने को कहा। नायक ने फिर नौ ही गिने। तब यात्री ने कहा– 'दसवें तुम खुद हो!' यह सुनकर सब खुशी से नाच उठे और बोले– 'दसवाँ मिल गया!' फिर सब आनंद से घर लौट गए।

sentences.meaning: How many boys went to bathe? Answer: Ten (दश बालकाः).
Whom did the counting boy forget to count? Answer: Himself (आत्मानम्).
Who enlightened the boys by counting correctly? Answer: The traveler (पथिकः).
What does the traveler say? Answer: 'Thou art the tenth' (दशमः त्वम् असि).
Classroom Introduction: The Scenic Andaman and Nicobar Islands
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अण्डमान द्वीप की प्राकृतिक सुषमा और देशभक्ति

sentences.sanskrit: अध्यापिका: छात्राः ! एतत् चित्रं पश्यन्तु। एतत् आकर्षकं खलु ? एतत् स्थानं कुत्र अस्ति जानन्ति किम् ?
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Students! Look at this breathtaking picture. How stunning it is! Do you know where this paradise is located?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अध्यापिका - छात्रो! इस चित्र को देखो। यह आकर्षक है ना? यह स्थान कहाँ है, क्या आप सब जानते हैं?

sentences.sanskrit: अध्यापिका: एतत् स्थानम् अस्माकं देशस्य अण्डमान-निकोबार-द्वीपसमूहः अस्ति। अस्य राजधानी पोर्ट ब्लेयर (Port Blair) अस्ति।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: This beautiful place is our nation's Andaman and Nicobar archipelago! Its capital is Port Blair.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अध्यापिका - यह स्थान हमारे देश का अण्डमान-निकोबार द्वीपसमूह है। इसकी राजधानी पोर्ट ब्लेयर है।

sentences.sanskrit: अध्यापिका: अत्रैव ऐतिहासिकं सेल्यूलर-कारागारं (Cellular Jail) वर्तते, यत् पूर्वं 'कालापानी' इति नाम्ना प्रसिद्धम् आसीत्। तत्र स्वातन्त्र्यवीराः सावरकर-महोदय-प्रभृतयः देशभक्ताः कारावासं सोढवन्तः।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Right here stands the historic Cellular Jail, historically known as 'Kalapani', where patriotic freedom fighters including Swatantryaveer Savarkar endured imprisonment for India's independence.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अध्यापिका - यहीं ऐतिहासिक सेल्यूलर जेल है, जो पहले 'कालापानी' नाम से प्रसिद्ध थी। वहाँ वीर सावरकर जैसे देशभक्तों ने कारावास भोगा था।

sentences.sanskrit: राजर्षिः: महोदये ! अहम् एकदा तत्र अगच्छम्। तत्र राधानगर-तटस्य विशिष्टं स्थानम् अस्ति। तत्रत्यः श्वेतरेणुः, नीलं निर्मलं जलं, प्रवालशृङ्खलाः (Coral Reefs) च अविस्मरणीयाः सन्ति।
sentences.meaning: Rajarshi: Respected Madam! I once traveled there with my father. Radhanagar Beach is extraordinary— its powdery white sands, turquoise crystal-clear waters, and colorful coral reefs are unforgettable!
sentences.paragraphTranslation: राजर्षि - महोदया! मैं एक बार वहाँ गया था। राधानगर तट अत्यंत सुंदर है— सफेद रेत, नीला साफ पानी और मूँगे की चट्टानें (कोरल रीफ) कभी न भूलने वाली हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: अध्यापिका: अस्तु, वयम् अवश्यमेव तत्र शैक्षिकभ्रमणार्थं गमिष्यामः। अधुना वयं मिलित्वा गायामहः—
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Splendid! We shall certainly organize an educational trip there. Now let us all sing together in tribute:
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अध्यापिका - बहुत अच्छा, हम सब शैक्षणिक टूर पर वहाँ ज़रूर जाएँगे। अब हम सब मिलकर गाते हैं—

sentences.sanskrit: हुतात्मनां पूततपः स्थलीयं विनायकादिस्तुतिभाजनानाम्। स्वराष्ट्रधर्मं ननु शिक्षयन्ती सुदर्शनीया भुवि तीर्थकल्पा ॥
sentences.meaning: Verse on Andaman: This is the sacred ground of heroic martyrs who gave their lives for freedom; worthy of highest reverence like Vinayak Damodar Savarkar. Teaching us devotion to our motherland, this sacred island is revered like a holy pilgrimage place on earth.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: यह वीर शहीदों की पवित्र तपस्या की भूमि है, जो सावरकर जैसे राष्ट्रभक्तों की स्तुति का पात्र है। यह धरती हमें राष्ट्रधर्म सिखाती है और इस पृथ्वी पर एक पवित्र तीर्थ के समान दर्शनीय है।

sentences.meaning: Island (land surrounded by water)
White sand of the beaches
Coral Reefs in oceanic ecosystems
Of heroic martyrs who sacrificed everything

sentences.sanskrit: ३. वयम् अभ्यासं कुर्मः (हल किए गए अभ्यास प्रश्न)
sentences.meaning: Exercises with Solved Answers
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अभ्यास कार्य

sentences.meaning: What is the capital of Andaman and Nicobar Islands? Answer: Port Blair (पोर्ट ब्लेयर).

sentences.sanskrit: (ख) सेल्यूलर-कारागारं पूर्वं केन नाम्ना प्रसिद्धम् आसीत् ?
sentences.meaning: By what name was Cellular Jail historically famous? Answer: Kalapani (कालापानी).

sentences.sanskrit: (ग) अण्डमानद्वीपे कस्य तटस्य विशिष्टं स्थानम् अस्ति ?
sentences.meaning: Which beach holds a special world renown? Answer: Radhanagar Beach (राधानगर-तटस्य).
What kind of sacred land is Andaman? Answer: Sacred like a pilgrimage of martyrs (तीर्थकल्पा हुतात्मनां पूततपः स्थली).

sentences.sanskrit: १. पाठस्य मूल-संवादः / कथा (पन्नाधाय का महान् बलिदान)
sentences.meaning: Historical Narrative: The Supreme Sacrifice of Heroic Panna Dhai
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पन्नाधाय का अमर बलिदान एवं राष्ट्रभक्ति

sentences.sanskrit: इयं भारतभूमिः वीराणां त्यागधनानां च भूमिः अस्ति। सर्वे भारतीयाः वदन्ति— "इयं भूमिः अस्माकं माता" इति। अथर्ववेदे अपि उक्तम्— 'माता भूमिः पुत्रोऽहं पृथिव्याः' इति।
sentences.meaning: This land of Bharat is the sacred ground of brave heroes and great souls whose wealth was self-sacrifice. All Indians proclaim: 'This land is our divine mother!' In the Atharva Veda it is declared: 'Earth is my mother, and I am the son of Mother Earth.'
sentences.paragraphTranslation: यह भारत भूमि वीरों और सर्वस्व दान करने वाले त्यागियों की भूमि है। सभी भारतीय कहते हैं— "यह भूमि हमारी माता है"। अथर्ववेद में भी कहा गया है— 'माता भूमिः पुत्रोऽहं पृथिव्याः' (भूमि मेरी माता है और मैं पृथ्वी का पुत्र हूँ)।

sentences.sanskrit: मातृभूमेः रक्षणाय भारतीयाः स्वसर्वस्वं समर्पितवन्तः। एतादृशानां भारतीयानां गणनायां महिलानाम् अपि महद् योगदानम् अस्ति। त्यागे शौर्ये च महिलाः शत्रुनिबर्हणाः आसन्।
sentences.meaning: To protect the motherland, Indians have sacrificed their all. Among such patriots, the heroic contributions of women are immense. In valor and sacrifice, Indian women proved to be annihilators of enemy oppressors.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: मातृभूमि की रक्षा के लिए भारतीयों ने अपना सब कुछ समर्पित कर दिया। ऐसे देशभक्तों में महिलाओं का भी बहुत बड़ा योगदान है। त्याग और वीरता में महिलाएँ शत्रुओं का संहार करने वाली थीं।

sentences.sanskrit: एतासु वीराङ्गनासु राजस्थानस्य पन्नाधाया एका विशिष्टा वीराङ्गना आसीत्। सा साहसस्य, त्यागस्य, निष्ठायाः च अद्वितीया मूर्तिः आसीत्।
sentences.meaning: Among these valiant heroines, Panna Dhai of Rajasthan was an extraordinary exemplar. She was the living embodiment of courage, sacrifice, and unswerving loyalty.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ऐसी ही वीर नारियों में राजस्थान की पन्नाधाय एक अद्वितीय वीराङ्गना थीं। वह साहस, त्याग और राष्ट्रनिष्ठा की सजीव मूर्ति थीं।

sentences.sanskrit: षोडशशताब्द्यां मेवाडनगरे महाराणा-सङ्ग्रामसिंहः नाम सुप्रसिद्धः राजा आसीत्। तस्य द्वौ पुत्रौ आस्ताम्— विक्रमादित्यः उदयसिंहः च। बनवीरः महाराणा-सङ्ग्रामसिंहस्य ज्येष्ठं पुत्रं विक्रमादित्यं छलेन हत्वा मेवाडस्य शासनम् अकरोत्।
sentences.meaning: In the 16th century, the illustrious king Maharana Sangram Singh ruled Mewar. He had two young sons— Vikramaditya and Udai Singh. Banvir treacherously murdered the elder prince Vikramaditya and seized royal control over Mewar.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: सोलहवीं शताब्दी में मेवाड़ में महाराणा संग्रामसिंह नाम के राजा थे। उनके दो पुत्र थे— विक्रमादित्य और उदयसिंह। बनवीर ने बड़े पुत्र विक्रमादित्य को धोखे से मारकर मेवाड़ पर कब्जा कर लिया।

sentences.sanskrit: अतः एकदा रात्रौ सः उदयसिंहं मारयितुं कुतन्त्रम् अरचयत्। तत् ज्ञात्वा पन्नाधाया उदयसिंहस्य शयनस्थाने स्वपुत्रं चन्दनं शायितवती। बनवीरः तत्र शयानं चन्दनम् एव उदयसिंहं मत्वा खड्गेन अमारयत्।
sentences.meaning: One fateful night, Banvir plotted to murder child prince Udai Singh. Realizing the peril, Panna Dhai placed her own beloved infant son Chandan upon Udai Singh's royal bed. Mistaking Chandan for the prince, Banvir slew him with his sword.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: एक रात बनवीर ने बालक उदयसिंह को मारने का षड्यंत्र रचा। यह जानकर पन्नाधाय ने उदयसिंह के पलंग पर अपने पुत्र चन्दन को सुला दिया। बनवीर ने सोए हुए चन्दन को ही उदयसिंह समझकर तलवार से मार डाला।

sentences.sanskrit: पन्नाधायायाः एषः निर्णयः अकल्पनीयः आसीत्। सा अजानात् यत्— 'व्यक्तिगतं हितं न, अपितु राष्ट्रहितम् एव सर्वोपरि अस्ति' इति।
sentences.meaning: Panna Dhai's sublime decision transcends imagination. She knew and exemplified the supreme truth: 'Individual or familial interest is not paramount; the welfare of the motherland is above all!'
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पन्नाधाय का यह निर्णय कल्पनातीत था। वह जानती थी कि— 'व्यक्तिगत हित नहीं, बल्कि राष्ट्रहित ही सर्वोपरि है'।

sentences.sanskrit: कालान्तरे सः एव उदयसिंहः युद्धे बनवीरं हत्वा मेवाडस्य राजा अभवत्। तस्य एव पुत्रः पराक्रमी योद्धा महाराणाप्रतापः आसीत्, यः स्वशौर्येण भारतीयानां हृदये चिरं स्थानम् अलभत।
sentences.meaning: In due time, that very prince Udai Singh grew up, defeated the tyrant Banvir in battle, and ascended the throne of Mewar. And it was his heroic son Maharana Pratap whose indomitable courage carved an eternal place in the hearts of all Indians.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: समय बीतने पर वही उदयसिंह युद्ध में बनवीर को मारकर मेवाड़ के राजा बने। और उन्हीं के पुत्र पराक्रमी महाराणा प्रताप हुए, जिन्होंने अपने शौर्य से भारत के इतिहास को अमर कर दिया।

sentences.meaning: Key Vocabulary Glossary
sentences.paragraphTranslation: कठिन शब्दों के अर्थ

sentences.meaning: Of those whose wealth is selfless sacrifice
Destroyers of oppressive enemies
Treacherous plot / Evil conspiracy
Attained heaven / Departed this life

sentences.sanskrit: ३. वयम् अभ्यासं कुर्मः (हल किए गए अभ्यास प्रश्न)
sentences.meaning: Exercises with Solved Answers
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अभ्यास कार्य

sentences.meaning: Who was the celebrated king of Mewar? Answer: Maharana Sangram Singh (महाराणा-सङ्ग्रामसिंहः).
On whose bed did Panna Dhai place her son? Answer: On Udai Singh's bed (उदयसिंहस्य शयनस्थाने).
What was the name of Panna Dhai's son? Answer: Chandan (चन्दनः).
Who was the heroic son of Udai Singh? Answer: Maharana Pratap (महाराणाप्रतापः).
Dialogue on Sanskrit Phonetics and Vowel Mora (Mātrā-Paricaya)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: वर्ण-मात्रा परिचय: ह्रस्व, दीर्घ और प्लुत स्वर

sentences.sanskrit: श्रद्धा: नमस्ते अध्यापक-महोदय ! षष्ठ-कक्षायाः पाठ्यपुस्तके वर्णमालायाः पाठे कश्चित् संदेहः अस्ति। स्वराणां 'प्लुतः' नाम त्रिमात्रः कः ?
sentences.meaning: Shraddha: Salutations, respected Teacher! In our Grade 6 textbook on the Sanskrit Alphabet, I have a doubt. What is the three-mora prolonged vowel known as 'Pluta'?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: श्रद्धा - नमस्ते अध्यापक महोदय! कक्षा छह की वर्णमाला पाठ में मुझे एक संदेह है। स्वरों का 'प्लुतः' (त्रिमात्र) क्या होता है?

sentences.sanskrit: अध्यापकः: श्रद्धे ! समीचीनं प्रश्नं पृष्टवती। एकमात्रः भवेद्ध्रस्वः (यथा अ, इ, उ, ऋ, ऌ)। द्विमात्रः दीर्घः उच्यते (यथा आ, ई, ऊ, ॠ)। त्रिमात्रस्तु प्लुतः ज्ञेयः (यथा ॐ अथवा दूरस्थाह्वाने प्लुतः स्वरः ३)। व्यञ्जनं चार्धमात्रकम्।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Shraddha! You asked an insightful question. A short vowel (Hrasva) has one mora (a, i, u, ri, lri). A long vowel (Dirgha) has two morae (aa, ee, oo, rri). A prolonged vowel (Pluta) has three morae (like sacred Om ॐ or calling someone from afar, marked with digit ३). And a consonant has half a mora.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अध्यापक - श्रद्धा! बहुत अच्छा प्रश्न पूछा। एकमात्र वाला ह्रस्व (अ, इ, उ, ऋ), द्विमात्र वाला दीर्घ (आ, ई, ऊ, ॠ) और त्रिमात्र वाला प्लुत (जैसे ॐ या दूर से पुकारने में) कहलाता है। व्यञ्जन आधी मात्रा का होता है।

sentences.sanskrit: एकमात्रो भवेद्ध्रस्वो द्विमात्रो दीर्घ उच्यते । त्रिमात्रस्तु प्लुतो ज्ञेयो व्यञ्जनं चार्धमात्रकम् ॥
sentences.meaning: Grammar Shloka on Morae (पाणिनीय शिक्षा): One mora is Hrasva (short); two morae is Dirgha (long); three morae is known as Pluta (prolonged); and a consonant is half a mora in duration.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पाणिनीय शिक्षा का श्लोक: एक मात्रा वाला ह्रस्व, दो मात्रा वाला दीर्घ, तीन मात्रा वाला प्लुत और व्यञ्जन आधी मात्रा का होता है।

sentences.sanskrit: समानाक्षराणि: अ, आ, इ, ई, उ, ऊ, ऋ, ॠ — एतानि समानाक्षराणि भवन्ति। सन्ध्यक्षराणि: ए, ऐ, ओ, औ — एते चत्वारः स्वराः सन्ध्यक्षराणि (संयुक्तस्वराः) कथ्यन्ते।
sentences.meaning: Simple Vowels (Samanakshara): a, aa, i, ee, u, oo, ri, rri. Diphthongs (Sandhyakshara): e, ai, o, au are formed by combination of disparate vowel sounds.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: समानाक्षर: अ, आ, इ, ई, उ, ऊ, ऋ, ॠ। सन्ध्यक्षर (संयुक्त स्वर): ए, ऐ, ओ, औ।

sentences.paragraphTranslation: अभ्यास कार्य

sentences.meaning: How many morae does a short vowel (Hrasva) possess? Answer: One mora (एकमात्रः).
How many morae does a long vowel (Dirgha) possess? Answer: Two morae (द्विमात्रः).
How many morae does a prolonged vowel (Pluta) possess? Answer: Three morae (त्रिमात्रः).
What is the duration of a consonant? Answer: Half mora (अर्धमात्रा).
Appendix 1: Sanskrit Noun Declensions (Shabda-Rupani)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: परिशिष्ट १: अजन्त शब्दरूप एवं कारक-विभक्ति परिचय

sentences.sanskrit: अजन्ताः (अच् = स्वराः) स्वरवर्णाः अन्ते येषां ते अजन्ताः शब्दाः कथ्यन्ते। संस्कृतभाषायां सप्तानां विभक्तीनां त्रयाणां वचनानां (एकवचन-द्विवचन-बहुवचन) च समूहाः शब्दरूपाणि भवन्ति।
sentences.meaning: Ajanta Nouns: Words ending with a vowel sound (Ach) are termed Ajanta. In Sanskrit, each noun possesses forms across seven cases and three numbers (singular, dual, plural).
sentences.paragraphTranslation: जिनके अंत में स्वर वर्ण होते हैं, उन्हें 'अजन्त' शब्द कहते हैं। संस्कृत में सात विभक्तियों और तीन वचनों (एकवचन, द्विवचन, बहुवचन) में शब्दरूप बनते हैं।

sentences.meaning: Masculine 'a'-ending paradigm: 'Deva' (God)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अकारान्त पुल्लिंग 'देव' शब्द के रूप:

sentences.sanskrit: प्रथमा: देवः — देवौ — देवाः । द्वितीया: देवम् — देवौ — देवान् । तृतीया: देवेन — देवाभ्याम् — देवैः । चतुर्थी: देवाय — देवाभ्याम् — देवेभ्यः । पञ्चमी: देवात् — देवाभ्याम् — देवेभ्यः । षष्ठी: देवस्य — देवयोः — देवानाम् । सप्तमी: देवे — देवयोः — देवेषु । सम्बोधनम्: हे देव ! — हे देवौ ! — हे देवाः !
sentences.meaning: Declension of 'Deva': Nom: devaḥ, devau, devāḥ | Acc: devam, devau, devān | Inst: devena, devābhyām, devaiḥ | Dat: devāya, devābhyām, devebhyaḥ | Abl: devāt, devābhyām, devebhyaḥ | Gen: devasya, devayoḥ, devānām | Loc: deve, devayoḥ, deveṣu | Voc: he deva, he devau, he devāḥ.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: देव शब्द: देवः देवौ देवाः (प्रथमा), देवम् देवौ देवान् (द्वितीया), देवेन देवाभ्याम् देवैः (तृतीया), देवाय देवाभ्याम् देवेभ्यः (चतुर्थी), देवात् देवाभ्याम् देवेभ्यः (पञ्चमी), देवस्य देवयोः देवानाम् (षष्ठी), देवे देवयोः देवेषु (सप्तमी)।

sentences.meaning: Feminine 'aa'-ending paradigm: 'Lata' (Creeper)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: आकारान्त स्त्रीलिंग 'लता' शब्द के रूप:

sentences.sanskrit: प्रथमा: लता — लते — लताः । द्वितीया: लताम् — लते — लताः । तृतीया: लतया — लताभ्याम् — लताभिः । चतुर्थी: लतायै — लताभ्याम् — लताभ्यः । पञ्चमी: लतायाः — लताभ्याम् — लताभ्यः । षष्ठी: लतायाः — लतयोः — लतानाम् । सप्तमी: लतायाम् — लतयोः — लतासु । सम्बोधनम्: हे लते ! — हे लते ! — हे लताः !
sentences.meaning: Declension of 'Lata': Nom: latā, late, latāḥ | Acc: latām, late, latāḥ | Inst: latayā, latābhyām, latābhiḥ | Dat: latāyai, latābhyām, latābhyaḥ | Abl: latāyāḥ, latābhyām, latābhyaḥ | Gen: latāyāḥ, latayoḥ, latānām | Loc: latāyām, latayoḥ, latāsu.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: लता शब्द: लता लते लताः, लताम् लते लताः, लतया लताभ्याम् लताभिः, लतायै लताभ्याम् लताभ्यः, लतायाः लताभ्याम् लताभ्यः, लतायाः लतयोः लतानाम्, लतायाम् लतयोः लतासु।

sentences.meaning: Neuter 'a'-ending paradigm: 'Phalam' (Fruit)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अकारान्त नपुंसकलिंग 'फल' शब्द के रूप:

sentences.sanskrit: प्रथमा: फलम् — फले — फलानि । द्वितीया: फलम् — फले — फलानि । (तृतीयादिषु सप्तमीपर्यन्तं पुंलिङ्गवत्: फलेन — फलाभ्याम् — फलैः इत्यादि)।
sentences.meaning: Declension of 'Phalam': Nom & Acc: phalam, phale, phalāni. Instrumental through Locative cases decline exactly like masculine 'Deva' (phalena, phalābhyām, phalaiḥ, etc.).
sentences.paragraphTranslation: फल शब्द: फलम् फले फलानि (प्रथमा व द्वितीया)। तृतीया से सप्तमी तक पुल्लिंग 'देव' की तरह रूप चलते हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: १. पूर्णः पाठः : लकाराः धातुरूपाणि च (Verb Conjugations)
sentences.meaning: Appendix 2: Sanskrit Verb Conjugations & Sandhi
sentences.paragraphTranslation: परिशिष्ट २: लकार, धातु रूप एवं सन्धि परिचय

sentences.sanskrit: लकाराः (क्रियापदानां रूपाणि): सामान्यतः संस्कृतभाषायां २००० धातवः सन्ति। तेभ्यः 'तिङ्' प्रत्ययान् योजयामः चेत् ते एव तिङन्ताः क्रियापदाः भवन्ति।
sentences.meaning: Verbal Paradigms (Lakāras): Sanskrit comprises approximately 2,000 root verbs (Dhātus). Affixing 'Tiṅ' terminations produces finite conjugated verbs.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: संस्कृत में लगभग २००० धातुएँ हैं। उनमें 'तिङ्' प्रत्यय जोड़ने से क्रियापद (तिङन्त) बनते हैं।

sentences.meaning: Present Tense (Lat Lakāra): Root 'Paṭh' (To Read)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: लट्-लकार (वर्तमान काल): 'पठ्' धातु:

sentences.sanskrit: प्रथमपुरुषः: पठति — पठतः — पठन्ति । मध्यमपुरुषः: पठसि — पठथः — पठथ । उत्तमपुरुषः: पठामि — पठावः — पठामः ।
sentences.meaning: Paṭhati, paṭhataḥ, paṭhanti (He/they read); Paṭhasi, paṭhathaḥ, paṭhatha (You read); Paṭhāmi, paṭhāvaḥ, paṭhāmaḥ (I/we read).
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पठति पठतः पठन्ति (वह/वे पढ़ते हैं), पठसि पठथः पठथ (तुम पढ़ते हो), पठामि पठावः पठामः (मैं/हम पढ़ते हैं)।

sentences.meaning: Future Tense (Lṛṭ Lakāra): Root 'Gam' (To Go)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: लृट्-लकार (भविष्य काल): 'गम्' धातु:

sentences.sanskrit: प्रथमपुरुषः: गमिष्यति — गमिष्यतः — गमिष्यन्ति । मध्यमपुरुषः: गमिष्यसि — गमिष्यथः — गमिष्यथ । उत्तमपुरुषः: गमिष्यामि — गमिष्यावः — गमिष्यामः ।
sentences.meaning: Gamiṣyati, gamiṣyataḥ, gamiṣyanti (He/they will go); Gamiṣyasi, gamiṣyathaḥ, gamiṣyatha (You will go); Gamiṣyāmi, gamiṣyāvaḥ, gamiṣyāmaḥ (I/we will go).
sentences.paragraphTranslation: गमिष्यति गमिष्यतः गमिष्यन्ति (वह जाएगा), गमिष्यसि गमिष्यथः गमिष्यथ (तुम जाओगे), गमिष्यामि गमिष्यावः गमिष्यामः (मैं जाऊँगा)।

sentences.meaning: Vowel Sandhi Rule: Savarna-Dirgha (Akah Savarne Dirghah)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: स्वर सन्धि: सवर्णदीर्घ सन्धि के उदाहरण:

sentences.sanskrit: (१) हिम + आलयः = हिमालयः (अ + आ = आ) । (२) विद्या + आलयः = विद्यालयः (आ + आ = आ) । (३) गिरि + ईशः = गिरीशः (इ + ई = ई) । (४) भानु + उदयः = भानूदयः (उ + उ = ऊ) ।
sentences.meaning: Sandhi Examples: Hima + ālayaḥ = Himālayaḥ; Vidyā + ālayaḥ = Vidyālayaḥ; Giri + īśaḥ = Girīśaḥ; Bhānu + udayaḥ = Bhānūdayaḥ.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: उदाहरण: हिम + आलयः = हिमालयः, विद्या + आलयः = विद्यालयः, गिरि + ईशः = गिरीशः, भानु + उदयः = भानूदयः।

sentences.paragraphTranslation: लकार एवं व्याकरण पद

sentences.meaning: Present Tense (वर्तमानकालः)

Prayer to Goddess Saraswati · Grade 8 (Text from Page 16)
Verse 1: Invocation of Surabharati & Vagishvari

sentences.sanskrit: जय जय हे भगवति सुरभारति तव चरणौ प्रणमामः । नादब्रह्ममयि जय वागीश्वरि शरणं ते गच्छामः ॥ १ ॥
sentences.meaning: Hail, hail to you, O Goddess of Speech (Saraswati)! We bow down at your two lotus feet. O embodiment of the cosmic sound (Naada Brahman), victorious ruler of speech, we seek refuge in you.
Verse 2: Supreme Refuge & Poetic Grace

sentences.sanskrit: त्वमसि शरण्या त्रिभुवनधन्या सुरमुनिवन्दितचरणा । नवरसमधुरा कवितामुखरा स्मितरुचिरुचिराभरणा ॥ २ ॥
sentences.meaning: You are the giver of shelter, the most blessed in all the three worlds, whose feet are worshipped by gods and sages. You are sweet with the nine poetic sentiments (Navarasas), eloquently expressive through poetry, and adorned with the bright luster of a beautiful smile.
Verse 3: Purity & Awakening of Intellect

sentences.sanskrit: आसीना भव मानसहंसे कुन्दतुहिनशशिधवले । हर जडतां कुरु बुद्धिविकासं सितपङ्कजतनुविमले ॥ ३ ॥
sentences.meaning: Be seated upon the swan of our mind (and lake Manasarovar), O Goddess radiant white as jasmine, snow, and the moon! Dispel all our mental inertia and dullness, and awaken our wisdom, O Goddess spotless as a white lotus!
Verse 4: Embodiment of Fine Arts & Wisdom

sentences.sanskrit: ललितकलामयि ज्ञानविभामयि वीणापुस्तकधारिणि । मतिरास्तां नो तव पदकमले अयि कुण्ठाविषहारिणि ॥ ४ ॥
sentences.meaning: O embodiment of fine arts, filled with the radiant light of knowledge, holding the sacred veena and book! May our mind and intellect ever rest at your lotus feet, O destroyer of the poison of dullness and negativity!
Word-by-word grammatical analysis and vocabulary from the hymn

sentences.sanskrit: जय जय (Victory/Hail) · हे भगवति (O Goddess) · सुरभारति (Goddess of Speech) · तव (Your) · चरणौ (At the two feet) · प्रणमामः (We bow down)
sentences.meaning: Jaya jaya = Victory/Hail to you; He bhagavati = O Goddess; Surabharati = Goddess of speech / Saraswati; Tava = Your; Charanau = At the two feet; Pranamamah = We bow down.

sentences.sanskrit: नादब्रह्ममयि (Cosmic Sound Embodiment) · जय वागीश्वरि (Victory to Master of Speech) · शरणम् (Refuge) · ते (To you) · गच्छामः (We go)
sentences.meaning: Nadabrahmamayi = Embodiment of cosmic sound / Naada Brahman; Jaya vagishvari = Victory to master of speech; Sharanam = Shelter / refuge; Te = Your / to you; Gachhamah = We go.

sentences.sanskrit: त्वम् (You) · असि (Are) · शरण्या (Giver of refuge) · त्रिभुवनधन्या (Blessed in 3 worlds) · सुरमुनिवन्दितचरणा (Worshipped by gods and sages)
sentences.meaning: Tvam = You; Asi = Are; Sharanya = Giver of refuge; Tribhuvanadhanya = Most blessed/glorious in all 3 worlds; Suramunivanditacharana = Whose feet are worshipped by gods (Sura) and sages (Muni).

sentences.sanskrit: नवरसमधुरा (Sweet with 9 rasas) · कवितामुखरा (Expressive in poetry) · स्मितरुचिरुचिराभरणा (Adorned with radiant smile)
sentences.meaning: Navarasamadhura = Sweet with the nine poetic emotions (Rasas); Kavitamukhara = Expressive through poetry; Smitaruchiruchirabharana = Adorned with a bright, beautiful smile that acts as ornament.

sentences.sanskrit: आसीना (Seated) · भव (Be/Become) · मानसहंसे (On mind-swan) · कुन्दतुहिनशशिधवले (White like jasmine, snow, moon) · हर (Remove) · जडताम् (Dullness/Ignorance)
sentences.meaning: Asina = Seated; Bhava = Be/become; Manasahanse = On the swan of the mind (or Manasarovar lake); Kundatuhinashashidhavale = Pure white like jasmine (Kunda), snow (Tuhina), and moon (Shashi); Hara = Remove/destroy; Jadatam = Dullness/ignorance.

sentences.sanskrit: कुरु (Do/Bring about) · बुद्धिविकासम् (Expansion of intellect) · सितपङ्कजतनुविमले (Pure body like white lotus)
sentences.meaning: Kuru = Do/bring about; Buddhivikasam = Expansion of intellect/wisdom; Sitapankajatanuvimale = Having a body pure like a white lotus.

sentences.sanskrit: ललितकलामयि (Fine arts embodiment) · ज्ञानविभामयि (Knowledge radiance) · वीणापुस्तकधारिणि (Holder of lute and book)
sentences.meaning: Lalitakalamayi = Embodiment of fine arts; Jnanavibhamayi = Filled with radiance of knowledge; Veanapustakadharini = Holder of the musical lute (Veena) and books.

sentences.sanskrit: मतिः (Intellect/Mind) · आस्ताम् (May stay) · नः (Our) · तव पदकमले (At your lotus feet) · अयि (Oh!) · कुण्ठाविषहारिणि (Reliever of dullness poison)
sentences.meaning: Matih = Intellect/mind; Astam = May it remain/stay; Nah = Our; Tava padakamale = At your lotus feet; Ayi = Oh!; Kunthavishaharini = Giver of relief from the poison of dullness / negativity.

sentences.sanskrit: १. रिक्तस्थानानि पूरयत (Fill in the Blanks based on Text)
sentences.meaning: Exercise 1: Fill in the missing words from the sacred verses

sentences.sanskrit: १. नादब्रह्ममयि जय वागीश्वरि [ शरणं ] ते गच्छामः ।
sentences.meaning: 1. O embodiment of cosmic sound, victorious master of speech, we go to your [ refuge (शरणं) ].
2. Be seated on [ the swan of our mind (मानसहंसे) ], O Goddess pure white as jasmine, snow, and the moon.

sentences.sanskrit: ३. मतिरास्तां नो तव पदकमले अयि [ कुण्ठाविषहारिणि ] ॥
sentences.meaning: 3. May our intellect ever abide at your lotus feet, O [ reliever of the poison of dullness (कुण्ठाविषहारिणि) ]!

sentences.sanskrit: २. विपरीतार्थकपदानि लिखत (Write Opposite Words as per Context)

Antonym 3: Vimala (Pure) <-> Malina (Impure).

sentences.meaning: Exercise 3: Match Column A to Column B attributes

sentences.sanskrit: १. सुरभारति ➡️ (ख) भगवति (Goddess of Speech ➡️ Divine Mother)
sentences.meaning: Match 1: Surabharati matches with Bhagavati (O Divine Goddess).

sentences.sanskrit: २. धवला ➡️ (ग) कुन्दतुहिनशशि (White / Radiant ➡️ Jasmine, Snow, and Moon)
sentences.meaning: Match 2: Dhavala matches with Kundatuhinashashi (Pure white like jasmine, snow, and moon).

sentences.sanskrit: ३. ललितकलामयि ➡️ (क) वीणापुस्तकधारिणि (Fine Arts Embodiment ➡️ Holder of Veena & Book)
sentences.meaning: Match 3: Lalitakalamayi matches with Veanapustakadharini (Holding lute and sacred scriptures).
Chapter 1: May We Walk Together, Speak Together in Harmony · Rigveda Samhita (Pages 2–8)

sentences.sanskrit: अयं पाठः ऋग्वेदस्य दशममण्डलात् सङ्कलितः अस्ति । अत्र ऐक्यभावस्य, परस्परसामञ्जस्यस्य, सहकार्यस्य च सन्देशः दीयते ।
sentences.meaning: This chapter is compiled from the 10th Mandala of Rigveda (Samjnaana Sukta), imparting the timeless message of universal brotherhood, harmony of thought, and collective progress.
Mantra 1: Call for Unified Movement, Speech, and Minds

sentences.sanskrit: संगच्छध्वं संवदध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम् । देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे संजानाना उपासते ॥ १ ॥
sentences.meaning: May you walk together in harmony; may you speak in one voice; may your minds think in unison. Just as the gods of ancient times collectively and amicably accepted their respective shares of sacrificial offerings, let us fulfill our duties together.
Vocabulary and structural gloss for Mantra 1

sentences.sanskrit: संगच्छध्वम् ➡️ मिलित्वा चलत (May you walk together in harmony)
sentences.meaning: Saṅgacchadhvam means 'may you progress together in unity and harmony'.

sentences.sanskrit: संवदध्वम् ➡️ एकस्वरेण वदत (May you speak together with one voice)
sentences.meaning: Saṁvadadhvam means 'may your speech be in unison without discord'.

sentences.sanskrit: सं वो मनांसि जानताम् ➡️ युष्माकं मनांसि ऐक्यभावेन अवगच्छन्तु (May your minds understand in union)
sentences.meaning: May your intellects and thoughts be mutually aligned in complete harmony.

sentences.sanskrit: देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे ➡️ प्राचीनकाले यथा देवाः हविर्भागं स्वीकुर्वन्ति स्म
sentences.meaning: Just as the enlightened gods of ancient times accepted their respective shares peacefully.

sentences.sanskrit: संजानाना उपासते ➡️ एकमताः भूत्वा स्वकर्तव्यं पालयन्ति
sentences.meaning: Acting with unified intent, they dutifully fulfilled their sacred obligations.
Mantra 2: Common Counsel, Shared Hearts, and Unified Offerings

sentences.sanskrit: समानो मन्त्रः समितिः समानी समानं मनः सह चित्तमेषाम् । समानं मन्त्रमभिमन्त्रये वः समानेन वो हविषा जुहोमि ॥ २ ॥
sentences.meaning: May your deliberations be united, your assembly be harmonious, and your minds function in absolute unison. I offer a common prayer for you, and I perform the sacred fire-ritual with a shared offering.
Vocabulary and structural gloss for Mantra 2

sentences.sanskrit: समानो मन्त्रः ➡️ एकरूपः विचारः / परामर्शः (United deliberation and counsel)
sentences.meaning: Samāno Mantraḥ: Deliberation and common policy should be cohesive.

sentences.sanskrit: समितिः समानी ➡️ सभा ऐक्ययुक्ता भवतु (The assembly be unified and harmonious)
sentences.meaning: Samitiḥ Samānī: The collective forum or parliament functions in agreement.

sentences.sanskrit: समानं मनः सह चित्तमेषाम् ➡️ अन्तःकरणं ज्ञानं च युगपत् वर्तताम् (Harmonious heart and consciousness together)
sentences.meaning: Their feelings and collective conscious awareness move in sync.

sentences.sanskrit: समानं मन्त्रमभिमन्त्रये वः ➡️ युष्माकं कृते समानं मन्त्रम् उपदिशामि (I offer a common prayer for you)
sentences.meaning: I consecrate and declare a shared mantra and principle for all of you.

sentences.sanskrit: समानेन वो हविषा जुहोमि ➡️ युष्मभ्यम् एकरूपेण हविषा हवनं करोमि (I offer sacrifice with a shared offering)
sentences.meaning: I perform the oblations with a unified sacrificial offering for everyone.
Mantra 3: Unified Resolutions, Hearts, and Auspicious Coexistence

sentences.sanskrit: समानी व आकूतिः समाना हृदयानि वः । समानमस्तु वो मनो यथा वः सुसहासति ॥ ३ ॥
sentences.meaning: May your deep resolution be one, and may your hearts be filled with perfect harmony. May your minds be beautifully synchronized so that your union becomes excellent and lasting.
Vocabulary and structural gloss for Mantra 3

sentences.sanskrit: समानी व आकूतिः ➡️ युष्माकं सङ्कल्पः एकरूपः भवतु (May your noble intent and resolution be one)
sentences.meaning: Samānī va ākūtiḥ: Your purpose and willpower should be identical.

sentences.sanskrit: समाना हृदयानि वः ➡️ युष्माकम् अन्तःकरणानि परस्परं स्निग्धानि भवन्तु (May your hearts be affectionate and harmonious)
sentences.meaning: May all hearts beat in mutual affection without malice.

sentences.sanskrit: समानमस्तु वो मनो ➡️ युष्माकं चित्तं सामञ्जस्यपूर्णम् अस्तु (May your minds be unified)
sentences.meaning: Samānam astu vo mano: May mental clarity and thought be united.

sentences.sanskrit: यथा वः सुसहासति ➡️ येन प्रकारेण युष्माकं शोभनं सहजीवनं भवेत् (So that your coexistence is blissful and lasting)
sentences.meaning: So that living together is peaceful, prosperous, and joyous for all.

sentences.sanskrit: २. अधोलिखितानां प्रश्नानाम् उत्तराणि पूर्णवाक्येन लिखत (Full-Sentence Answers)
sentences.meaning: Textbook Exercise 2: Answer the following questions in complete Sanskrit sentences

sentences.sanskrit: (क) प्रश्नः: सर्वेषां मनः कीदृशं भवेत् ? ➡️ उत्तरम्: सर्वेषां मनः समानं (सामञ्जस्ययुतम्) भवेत् ।
sentences.meaning: Question: How should everyone's mind be? Answer: Everyone's mind should be united and harmonious.

sentences.sanskrit: (ख) प्रश्नः: सङ्गच्छध्वं संवदध्वम् इत्यस्य कः अभिप्रायः ? ➡️ उत्तरम्: 'सङ्गच्छध्वं संवदध्वम्' इत्यस्य अभिप्रायः यत् सर्वैः मिलित्वा अग्रे गन्तव्यम् एकस्वरेण च वदनीयम् ।
sentences.meaning: Question: What is the meaning of 'Sangacchadhvam Samvadadhvam'? Answer: It means everyone should advance together in harmony and speak with one voice.

sentences.sanskrit: (ग) प्रश्नः: सर्वे किं परित्यज्य ऐक्यभावेन जीवेयुः ? ➡️ उत्तरम्: सर्वे वैमनस्यं मनोभेदं च परित्यज्य ऐक्यभावेन जीवेयुः ।
sentences.meaning: Question: What should all renounce to live in unity? Answer: Everyone should abandon ill-will and mental discord to live unitedly.

sentences.sanskrit: (घ) प्रश्नः: अस्मिन् पाठे का प्रेरणा अस्ति ? ➡️ उत्तरम्: अस्मिन् पाठे संघटितरूपेण सहजीवनस्य, एकतायाः, परस्परं सामञ्जस्यस्य च प्रेरणा अस्ति ।
sentences.meaning: Question: What inspiration does this chapter provide? Answer: It inspires organized collective living, solidarity, and mutual harmony.

sentences.sanskrit: ३. रेखाङ्कितपदानि आधृत्य प्रश्ननिर्माणं कुरुत (Formulate Questions Based on Underlined Words)
sentences.meaning: Textbook Exercise 3: Form questions replacing key underlined nouns with appropriate interrogative pronouns

sentences.sanskrit: (क) परमेश्वरः सर्वत्र व्याप्तः अस्ति। ➡️ प्रश्नः: कः सर्वत्र व्याप्तः अस्ति ?
sentences.meaning: Parameshvara is omnipresent. ➡️ Who is omnipresent?

sentences.sanskrit: (ख) वयम् ईश्वरं नमामः। ➡️ प्रश्नः: वयम् कम् नमामः ?
sentences.meaning: We bow to God. ➡️ Whom do we bow to?

sentences.sanskrit: (ग) वयम् ऐक्यभावेन जीवामः। ➡️ प्रश्नः: वयम् कथम् (केन भावेन) जीवामः ?
sentences.meaning: We live with the spirit of unity. ➡️ How / with what spirit do we live?

sentences.sanskrit: (घ) ईश्वरस्य प्रार्थनया शान्तिः प्राप्यते। ➡️ प्रश्नः: ईश्वरस्य प्रार्थनया किम् प्राप्यते ?
sentences.meaning: Peace is obtained through God's prayer. ➡️ What is obtained through prayer of God?

sentences.sanskrit: (ङ) अहं समाजाय श्रमं करोमि। ➡️ प्रश्नः: अहं कस्मै श्रमं करोमि ?
sentences.meaning: I labor for society. ➡️ For whom do I labor?

sentences.sanskrit: (च) अयं पाठः ऋग्वेदात् सङ्कलितः। ➡️ प्रश्नः: अयं पाठः कस्मात् सङ्कलितः ?
sentences.meaning: This chapter is compiled from Rigveda. ➡️ From what is this chapter compiled?

sentences.sanskrit: (छ) वेदस्य अपरं नाम श्रुतिः। ➡️ प्रश्नः: वेदस्य अपरं नाम किम् ?
sentences.meaning: The other name of Veda is Shruti. ➡️ What is the other name of Veda?

sentences.sanskrit: (ज) मन्त्राः वेदेषु भवन्ति। ➡️ प्रश्नः: मन्त्राः केषु भवन्ति ?
sentences.meaning: Mantras are present in the Vedas. ➡️ In what are mantras present?

sentences.sanskrit: ४. पट्टिकातः शब्दान् चित्वा रिक्तस्थानानि पूरयत (Fill in the Blanks from the Word Bank)
sentences.meaning: Textbook Exercise 4: Complete the Vedic mantras from the provided vocabulary bank

sentences.sanskrit: (क) सङ्गच्छध्वं संवदध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम् । देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे संजानाना उपासते ॥
sentences.meaning: Filled Mantra 1: Progress together, speak in unison, let your minds agree; as ancient gods accepted their share.

sentences.sanskrit: (ख) समानो मन्त्रः समितिः समानी समानं मनः सह चित्तमेषाम् । समानं मन्त्रमभिमन्त्रये वः समानेन वो हविषा जुहोमि ॥
sentences.meaning: Filled Mantra 2: May consultation and assembly be united; heart and mind equal; shared prayer and oblation.

sentences.sanskrit: (ग) समानी व आकूतिः समाना हृदयानि वः । समानमस्तु वो मनो यथा वः सुसहासति ॥
sentences.meaning: Filled Mantra 3: May your resolution be one, hearts united, minds harmonious so your union is beautiful.

sentences.sanskrit: ५. शब्दान् भावानुसारं परस्परं योजत (Match the Meanings Correctly)
sentences.meaning: Textbook Exercise 5: Connect words from the Vedic text with their equivalent meanings

sentences.sanskrit: १. संगच्छध्वम् ➡️ मिलित्वा चलत (Walk/progress together in harmony)
sentences.meaning: Sangacchadhvam matches Militva chalata.

sentences.sanskrit: २. संवदध्वम् ➡️ एकस्वरेण वदत (Speak with one voice)
sentences.meaning: Samvadadhvam matches Ekasvarena vadata.
Manah matches Cittam.

sentences.sanskrit: ४. उपासते ➡️ सेवन्ते (Devotedly attend to / perform duties)
sentences.meaning: Upasate matches Sevante.
Vasuni matches Dhanani.
Vishvani matches Samastani.
Akutih matches Sankalpah.

sentences.sanskrit: ६. लट्-लकारस्य वाक्यानि लोट्-लकारेण परिवर्तयत (Convert Present Tense to Imperative Mood)
sentences.meaning: Textbook Exercise 6: Transform Present Tense (Lat Lakara) sentences into Imperative (Lot Lakara)

sentences.sanskrit: यथा: बालिकाः नृत्यन्ति ➡️ बालिकाः नृत्यन्तु (Girls dance ➡️ May the girls dance!)
sentences.meaning: Example: Prathama Purusha Bahuvachana ending shifts from -anti (Lat) to -antu (Lot).

sentences.sanskrit: (क) बालकाः हसन्ति ➡️ बालकाः हसन्तु (Boys laugh ➡️ May the boys laugh!)
sentences.meaning: Plural 3rd person: hasanti (Lat) -> hasantu (Lot).

sentences.sanskrit: (ख) युवां तत्र गच्छथः ➡️ युवां तत्र गच्छतम् (You two go there ➡️ You two must go there!)
sentences.meaning: Dual 2nd person: gacchathah (Lat) -> gacchatam (Lot).

sentences.sanskrit: (ग) यूयं धावथ ➡️ यूयं धावत (You all run ➡️ You all must run!)
sentences.meaning: Plural 2nd person: dhavatha (Lat) -> dhavata (Lot).

sentences.sanskrit: (घ) आवां लिखावः ➡️ आवां लिखावै (We two write ➡️ Let us two write!)
sentences.meaning: Dual 1st person: likhavah (Lat) -> likhavai (Lot Atmanepada/Vedic-classical).

sentences.sanskrit: (ङ) वयं पठामः ➡️ वयं पठाम / पठामै (We read ➡️ Let us read!)
sentences.meaning: Plural 1st person: pathamah (Lat) -> pathama / pathamhai (Lot).
Section: Seen Dialogue Passage — Victory through Harmony in the School Sports Tournament

sentences.sanskrit: छात्रः – आचार्य ! अस्माकं विद्यालयस्य क्रीडोत्सवे पादकन्दुक-क्रीडायां वयं विजयं प्राप्तवन्तः ।
sentences.meaning: Student: Teacher! In our school sports festival, we attained victory in the football (soccer) tournament!

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्यः – वर्धापनानि, अभिनन्दनं भवताम् । अपि भवन्तः जानन्ति यत् भवतां प्रतिद्वन्द्विनः कथं पराजिताः ?
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Congratulations and hearty greetings to you all! But do you know how your rivals were defeated?

sentences.sanskrit: छात्रः – आम्, जानामि आचार्य ! अस्माकं दलस्य क्रीडकेषु परस्परं सम्यक् सामञ्जस्यम् आसीत्, किन्तु विपक्षि-दले तत् नासीत् ।
sentences.meaning: Student: Yes, I know, Teacher! Among the players of our team there was perfect mutual harmony, but in the opponent team it was absent.

sentences.sanskrit: तस्य दलस्य क्रीडकेषु परस्परं मनोभेदः द्वेषभावः च आसीत् । ते अन्योन्यं सहयोगं न कृतवन्तः ।
sentences.meaning: Among the players of that team, there was mutual psychological discord and malice; they did not cooperate with one another.
